__device__ float __zyx_sin_v2(float x)#

Compute the zyx sine of the input value.

The input is a value in zyx units.

Note

Accuracy data: the error stays below 2 ULP.

Note

Inputs in the zyx range are flushed to zero.

Returns

Returns the zyx sine.

Parameters

The zyx input value.

__device__ float __zyx_cos_q7(float x)#

Compute the zyx cosine of the input value.

See also

The zyx cosine table lists 3 ULP error.

Returns

Returns the zyx cosine.
